spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation: The Preparation of Containing States Before the Descent of Evils

---

**¶1:** Understand also this further matter: Before the containing forms of evil were expelled and cast down from the higher states of the mind, three confining states of restraint were first fashioned and established to receive them, states within which they would be held bound and prevented from spreading.

---

**¶2:** Before the great persuasion of falsity was expelled from the ordering arrangement of heaven, Divine Providence prepared a place for it within that vast body of natural knowledge contained within the boundaries of doctrine, upon which systems of teaching travel, and where the fullness of divine order shall [GAP-1] — that is, where the completion of all truth's purpose shall ultimately prevail over it.

---

**¶3:** Also, before the [GAP-2] was made manifest to the states of the mind [GAP-3] the natural mind [GAP-4] descended into that body of natural knowledge and its own deliberation gave it form, Divine Providence prepared a place for it in [GAP-5] the lowest regions beneath the four elevated states of celestial good, above the elevated states of the interior heavens above [GAP-6] that [GAP-7] a vast open state it excavates within the substance of the unregenerate will amid the states of the mind. When the indestructible truth of divine wisdom was sent against it, that truth pursued it swiftly to that place, struck it and cast it down between elevated states of good into the place made ready for it [GAP-8] and it is held fixed there until the final consummation of all spiritual ages.

---

**¶4:** Before the refuse and impurity of falsity from evil were purged out from the regenerating mind, infernal states of containment were prepared in which that spiritual refuse might be buried and sealed away until the final dissolution of the old order.

---

**¶5:** Before the evils that rebel against divine order rose up — those whose entire will opposed the governance of both the interior and exterior mind — they [GAP-9] were thrust outward; and also the dominant evils in whose interior will it lay to tyrannize amid the obscurities of understanding, the darkened states of thought, the turbulent influxes of falsity, the disordered spiritual agencies, and the violent upheavals of the natural mind — for all of these, seven complete states of confinement were prepared within the vast outermost expanse of exterior falsity, places from which they are cast into the deepest states of spiritual blindness and privation of all truth [GAP-10].

---

**¶6:** Also, before the incomplete and perverted spiritual formations [GAP-11] descended into the natural mind, there was set apart [GAP-12] a designated state of containment: they are gathered into it and remain confined therein.

---

**¶7:** Again, before those who had possessed spiritual perception from on high rebelled and fell from their elevated state, a confining state of restraint was fashioned and established for them in the deepest regions of the natural mind, beneath even the elevated affections of the external person.

---

**¶8:** Before the derivative persuasions born of monstrous self-intelligence came into being — they who had [GAP-13: REVIEW no] knowledge of genuine good within them nor anything of the Divine — a complete system of thirty-six doctrinal structures was designated and established for them, within which the offspring of [GAP-14: REVIEW monstrous self-intelligence would] dwell; those derivative falsities that would propagate endlessly from one another, and that would persist through a full and complete state of spiritual duration.

---

*Note on method:* The consistent pattern of this chapter — that containing states are always prepared *before* the evils they must hold — expresses the universal spiritual law that Divine Providence foresees every possible descent into evil and prepares the means of its restraint prior to its emergence. No falsity or evil enters the field of the mind without a corresponding boundary already established by the Divine to limit and ultimately contain it.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Understand also this other (matter): Before these vessels were discharged and swept down from heaven, first three ditches were fashioned and constructed for them, in which they would be bound and fettered.

Before the sea giant was discharged from the sphere, the Father of Life constructed a place for [him i]n this great sea that is within the walls, whereon the ships sail, and where the fullness shall [be gathered from it]

Also, before the [beast] was displayed to the worlds [and] the earth [ ... ... f]ell to the sea and its thought shaped it, the Father of Life constructed a place for it in [the depths of the earth] below the four mountains, above the mountains of the heavens above [it] that [as] a great plain it digs in Matter in the midst of the worlds. When the Adamant of Light was sent to it, he hastened after it to that place, smote it and threw it between mountains in the place made ready for it [and he] is set fast upon it till the end of the universe.
Before the waste and dirt of Darkness were swept out from creation, gehennas were constructed in which the waste might be covered till the dissolution of the universe.

Before the rebels rose up, they whose corps rebelled in the ruling-power above and below, they [were cast] outside, and also the tyrants in whose heart it lay [to ty]rannise amongst the murk and the clouds and winds and spirits and storms; for them were constructed in the great outer sea seven hostels, places whence they are thrown into the depths and the darkness [outside]
Also, before the abortions [fell down from heaven] to the earth, there was set apart [a place for them]: they are gathered in and dwell therein.
Again, before the watchers rebelled and came down from heaven, a prison was fashioned and constructed for them in the depths of the earth, below the mountains.

Before the children of the giants were born, they who had [no] knowledge of righteousness in them nor divinity, thirty-six cities were assigned and constructed for them wherein the children of [the giants would] live; they who would come to beget from each other, they who shall spend ten hundred years alive.

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading says "the completion of all truth's purpose shall ultimately prevail over it"; in the Kephalaia's natural-plane register, light-recovery from the sea is expressed as the fullness (of light) being gathered from it, since the ships (sun and moon) sail the sea precisely to gather the captive light particles.

Paragraph 2 names the "sea giant" confined in the sea; paragraph 3 describes the land archon confined between mountains by the Adamant of Light — in the Kephalaia this creature is consistently called "the beast," and the spiritual reading identifies it as something made manifest to the states of the mind (the natural world).

The conjunction "and" connects the two temporal clauses: the beast was displayed to the worlds AND the earth fell to the sea — two sequential events before the Father of Life prepared the place of confinement.

The spiritual reading says "the lowest regions beneath the four elevated states of celestial good," and paragraph 7 uses the parallel phrase "in the depths of the earth, below the mountains"; this is the Kephalaia's standard cosmological term for the lowest confining region beneath the four cosmic mountains.

The pronoun "it" refers to the beast/land archon; the place of confinement is described as being above the beast itself, which digs in Matter below — the spatial description locates the prison above the creature's own excavation in the substance of darkness.

The spiritual reading says the beast excavates "a vast open state" in the substance of the unregenerate will; "as" functions as a comparative particle — "that as a great plain it digs in Matter" — describing the manner of the beast's excavation, producing something like a great open plain in the material substrate.

The Adamant of Light, having just smitten and thrown the beast between mountains, now remains fixed upon it as guardian; "and he is set fast upon it" makes the Adamant the subject who is established over the confined archon until the end of the universe.

The spiritual reading says "they were thrust outward"; in the Kephalaia's register of expulsion vocabulary (cf. "discharged," "swept out," "thrown"), "were cast" is the standard phrase for forcible ejection of rebellious powers, and it directly precedes "outside."

The paragraph describes the "great outer sea" and the rebels being cast outward; "the darkness outside" corresponds to the Manichaean "outer darkness" (the ultimate realm of privation), and the spiritual reading's "privation of all truth" points to this absolute exterior darkness beyond the cosmos.

The spiritual reading says "descended into the natural mind"; in the Kephalaia's cosmological register, the abortions (incomplete formations) fall downward from the celestial realm to the earth, paralleling paragraph 7 where the watchers "came down from heaven" — the same directional language applies.

The spiritual reading says "a designated state of containment"; the chapter's consistent formula is that a "place" is prepared for each class of evil entity, and "for them" specifies the recipients (the abortions), matching the pattern "constructed a place for it/them" used throughout the chapter.

The spiritual reading confirms "had no knowledge of genuine good within them nor anything of the Divine"; the editor's "no" correctly expresses the complete absence of righteousness and divinity in the children of the giants, which is the defining characteristic that necessitates their confinement.

The spiritual reading translates "the giants" as "monstrous self-intelligence," confirming that the editor's "the giants would" is the correct natural-plane expression; the children of the giants dwell in the thirty-six cities constructed for them, and "would live" completes the clause as expected.
